candidate.prompt_text: Look at these sports: badminton and football. Which sport would you choose to play after school? Say the name of the sport clearly and tell why you choose it.
suggested_ideas: Mention one or two simple reasons
Use the sport names clearly more than once

evaluation_guide.expected_content: The student chooses one of the two sports and gives simple personal reasons. The response should include clear pronunciation of key words, especially the stress in sport names and common supporting words.
evaluation_guide.key_points: Choice of one sport; at least one relevant reason; understandable short response; clear word stress in words such as BADminton, FOOTball, EXercise, ENergy, TEAmwork.
evaluation_guide.acceptable_responses: A brief answer is acceptable, for example choosing badminton because it is fun or football because it is active. Minor grammar errors are acceptable if the response is understandable and the target words are pronounced with mostly correct stress.
evaluation_guide.off_topic_examples: Talking only about a famous athlete; discussing rules in detail without making a choice; talking about school subjects instead of sports; giving memorized content unrelated to the two sports.
evaluation_guide.scoring_hints: Focus mainly on whether word stress helps listener understanding. Give higher scores when the student places stress correctly in common two- or three-syllable words and repeats key sport words clearly. Do not over-penalize simple grammar or limited ideas.
evaluation_guide.common_mistakes: Flat stress on all syllables; stressing the wrong syllable in BADminton or EXercise; speaking too softly to judge stress; listing words without a clear choice; long pauses that break word rhythm.

candidate.prompt_text: Which do you prefer for staying healthy: running, swimming, or cycling? Choose one and give two short reasons. Try to say the activity words clearly.
suggested_ideas: Say how it helps your health or feelings
Add one simple detail such as easy, fun, or relaxing

evaluation_guide.expected_content: The student selects one activity from the list and gives two short reasons connected to health or personal preference. The response should show clear word stress in the activity names and a few common content words.
evaluation_guide.key_points: One clear choice; two short reasons; relevant vocabulary; understandable pronunciation; word stress in RUNning, SWIMming, CYcling, HEalthy, reLAXing if used.
evaluation_guide.acceptable_responses: Simple personal answers are acceptable, such as preferring running because it is easy and gives energy, or swimming because it is relaxing and good exercise. Limited vocabulary is acceptable if the message is clear.
evaluation_guide.off_topic_examples: Describing all three activities without choosing one; talking about watching sports on TV only; discussing professional competitions; giving unrelated opinions about food or study.
evaluation_guide.scoring_hints: Assess whether stressed syllables are placed naturally enough for easy understanding. Reward clear contrast between stressed and unstressed syllables. Keep the main focus on pronunciation rather than idea complexity.
evaluation_guide.common_mistakes: Wrong stress in CYcling or reLAXing; unclear endings that make the word hard to recognize; speaking word by word with no stress pattern; giving only one reason when two are requested.

candidate.prompt_text: Some students like team sports, and some like individual sports. Which do you prefer? Give one example and explain your choice.
suggested_ideas: Say team sport or individual sport
Give one example such as football, volleyball, badminton, or running
Explain with one or two simple reasons

evaluation_guide.expected_content: The student states a preference between team and individual sports, gives one example, and explains the choice briefly. Pronunciation should show clear word stress in category words and the example sport.
evaluation_guide.key_points: Clear preference; one suitable example; simple explanation; understandable speech; attention to stress in INdividual, VOLleyball, FOOTball, BADminton, RUNning.
evaluation_guide.acceptable_responses: A short comparison is acceptable, for example preferring team sports because playing with others is more exciting, or individual sports because they feel calmer. Small grammar mistakes are acceptable if the meaning is clear.
evaluation_guide.off_topic_examples: Talking only about friends or school clubs without mentioning a sport type; discussing famous teams or players instead of personal choice; giving a general definition with no preference.
evaluation_guide.scoring_hints: Prioritize correct word stress and overall intelligibility. Give stronger scores when multisyllable words are stressed naturally and the sport example is pronounced clearly. Content can remain simple.
evaluation_guide.common_mistakes: Mis-stressing INdividual or VOLleyball; not giving any example; repeating memorized phrases with unclear stress; comparing many sports without answering the main question clearly.
